lines: If a pond has a single lily pad that doubles every day and it takes 30 days to cover the whole pond, on what day is the pond half covered?
One of the most important, but least intuitive concepts to the human brain is compounding, because compounding looks like almost nothing for a long time until everything happens all at once.
If you're watching this, I bet you're closer to day 29 than you think.
And all you need to do is have the consistency to see day 30.
I love tracking my habits, so I wanted to make an app that shows the exponential curve in real time when you log an activity.
To let cursors agents go to work using their new composer model, and it did not disappoint.
This is what I built when I was away from my computer.
Allows you to track habits and see the compounding effects.
If you want the software I used to make it, comment, fire.

spine.big_idea: Compounding looks like nothing for a long time, so you're probably closer to your breakthrough than you think.
spine.before: I'm putting in effort and not getting anywhere
spine.after: I'm probably closer than I think, so I should keep going
spine.viewer: People working on habits or goals who feel progress is too slow
spine.format: riddle → answer → hidden lesson → this is you → what to do → demo → comment for the tool
spine.hook_promise: A riddle you can guess, with the answer coming right away
spine.ask: Comment 'fire' to get the software; trades on the speed of the demo
why: The riddle makes you guess before it teaches the lesson
It turns the lesson onto the viewer: you are near day 29
The demo is fast and makes the concept feel doable today

points.summary: Compounding looks like nothing for a long time, then everything happens
You are probably closer to your breakthrough than you think
Consistency is all you need to reach day 30
An app can show the compounding curve as you log habits

chunks.wonder: wait, why day 29, what does that mean?
okay, so how does this apply to me?
so what do I do about it?

card.name: Riddle to tool
card.use_when: there's a mental model that changes how people see their own progress, and a tool or demo that makes it real.
card.needs: a real riddle or example for the model, and something I built or use. Missing → drop the demo and end on the reframe.
card.reframe: beat 4, right after the lesson. Never line 1.

beats.name: Hook
beats.job: ask a question the viewer wants to guess, with a clear answer coming.

beats.name: Payoff
beats.job: give the answer in one short line so the surprise lands.

beats.name: Name it
beats.job: say the hidden idea the riddle shows, in plain words and why it feels wrong.

beats.name: Reframe
beats.job: turn the lesson to the viewer and tell them where they probably are.

beats.name: Steps
beats.job: one line on what they need to do to get the payoff.

beats.name: Example
beats.job: show something made or used that puts the lesson to work, with proof of how fast.

beats.name: CTA
beats.job: optional. One comment keyword that gets them the tool.

flex: Beat 7 can drop if there's nothing to give.
The demo can be a story or example instead of a tool.
